svg.title: One transcript feeds the captions, the summary, and the chat
svg.desc: A YouTube watch page with the Better YouTube side panel beside it. The transcript, 2,666 timed lines read from the open page, runs as one red band beneath them, starting with 0:00 My name is Terence Tao. I'm a professor. It feeds the panel's Transcript section and two models. The caption model gets the lines in 134 batches of 20, eight at a time; each request carries the title, the names the transcript repeats, numbered lines such as [LINE1], and four neighbouring lines for context, while the timestamps stay behind; replies come back by ID onto the video, the first five minutes first. Its three options are Refine in the same language, Translate to English, and Translate to another language. The summary and chat model gets the whole transcript in every request and returns a Markdown summary, saved only on success, and answers in the chat.
